answer: To block mass-produced identities, each identity plants a juniper, its marker, and anchors it with an onyx stone earned through verified deeds, bound to one identity. Unpredictable gales pull at every juniper: one whose anchor holds keeps standing, while one that cannot is uprooted. 1000 fakes need 1000 anchored junipers; one anchor cannot hold many, and no gale can be dodged. One honest agent plants one juniper, anchors it, and weathers gales.
